items.headline: RBI expected to hike repo rates by 25 bps in December and February amid elevated inflation
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to maintain its hawkish stance, with further 25 basis points repo rate hikes expected in December and February due to elevated inflation, which is tracking close to 6.3% in November, primarily driven by rising food prices.

items.headline: RBI proposes ₹50 lakh sub-limit within Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS)
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has reportedly proposed a ₹50 lakh sub-limit for transactions under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) to mitigate massive dollar outflows from the country.

items.headline: RBI considering new regulations for PE firms acquiring controlling stakes in multiple NBFCs
items.summary: To prevent financial stress contagion, the RBI is contemplating new regulations that would restrict private equity firms from acquiring controlling stakes in multiple non-banking financial companies (NBFCs).

items.headline: RBI Deputy Governor raises concerns on microfinance repayment limits and recovery practices
items.summary: The RBI Deputy Governor expressed concerns regarding the increasing size of microfinance loans, the adequacy of repayment limits, and potentially aggressive recovery practices employed by lenders in the sector.

items.headline: Indian markets to open lower amidst mixed global signals
items.summary: Indian equity benchmarks are anticipated to open with a gap-down, influenced by a sharp downturn in US technology stocks overnight ahead of Nvidia's earnings, despite some mixed performance in Asian markets post Nvidia's better-than-expected results.

items.headline: US tech stocks fall sharply ahead of Nvidia earnings, global AI trade concerns persist
items.summary: US stock markets experienced a significant downturn, particularly in technology stocks, in anticipation of Nvidia's earnings. Broader investor caution is being driven by ongoing concerns over the global AI trade and rising US Treasury yields.

items.headline: Nifty Bank index reaches record highs, driving Indian equity market resilience
items.summary: Indian equity markets demonstrated resilience despite weak global cues, primarily driven by banking stocks, with the Nifty Bank index achieving new record highs. Automobile and infrastructure sectors also saw healthy buying interest.

items.headline: Indian IT stocks underperform amid global technology demand concerns
items.summary: The Indian IT sector experienced underperformance in the market, largely due to ongoing global concerns regarding demand for technology services and products.

items.headline: Ashoka Buildcon emerges as L-1 bidder for ₹1,465 crore NHAI expressway project
items.summary: Ashoka Buildcon is in focus after emerging as the lowest bidder (L-1) for a significant National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) project, valued at ₹1,465 crore, involving an eight-lane section of the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway in Gujarat.

items.headline: Prestige Estates' subsidiary acquires 50% stake in Mumbai commercial project JV
items.summary: Prestige Estates Projects will be watched following its wholly-owned subsidiary's acquisition of a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International Private Limited, a joint venture developing a commercial project in Mumbai with an estimated leasable area of 1.50 million square feet.

items.headline: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd to begin IPO bidding for anchor investors
items.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd (MCL), a subsidiary of Coal India, is scheduled to commence bidding for anchor investors today for its ₹8,981-crore Initial Public Offering (IPO). The IPO's price band is fixed at ₹129 to ₹136 per equity share, with public subscription opening on November 19, 2026.

items.headline: Tata Group stocks remain in spotlight over Tata Sons listing discussions
items.summary: Tata Group stocks continue to be in focus due to ongoing discussions and a recent letter from a former trustee questioning the proposed listing of Tata Sons, creating market speculation.

items.headline: Welspun Living receives 'Go long' recommendation with target of ₹295
items.summary: Raja Venkatraman of NeoTrader has issued a 'Go long' recommendation for Welspun Living (CMP ₹265.60), setting a target price of ₹295, supported by strong Q1 numbers and a revival in the sector.

items.headline: Delhivery recommended as 'Go long' call after steep sell-off
items.summary: Delhivery (CMP ₹457.95) has received a 'Go long' recommendation from Raja Venkatraman of NeoTrader, indicating signs of revival for the stock after experiencing a steep sell-off.
